steps.title: Open Integrations
steps.description: Click the Integrations tab in the sidebar to see available connections.

steps.title: Connect GoHighLevel
steps.description: Click this button to start the GHL connection process.

steps.title: Paste your API key
steps.description: Go to GHL Settings → API → copy your key and paste it here.

steps.title: Save Connection
steps.description: Click Save to complete the connection. You'll see a success message when done.
